WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), above_first AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_unfilled, p.avg_unfilled - b.benchmark AS excess_first
  FROM per_order AS p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_unfilled > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark
  FROM above_first
), above_second AS (
  SELECT a.avg_unfilled, a.excess_first, a.avg_unfilled - b.benchmark AS excess_second
  FROM above_first AS a
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b
  WHERE a.avg_unfilled > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS remaining_average,
       AVG(excess_first) AS average_excess_over_first,
       AVG(excess_second) AS average_excess_over_second
FROM above_second;

assumptions.assumption: NULL ordersmark values are grouped together as one order, while NULL remaincount values are ignored by AVG; orders with no non-NULL remaincount are excluded.
